name: Tử Đằng Không Lá
source:
You play as a painter whose dearest friend betrayed her, stealing the masterpiece she poured her soul into. Refusing to give up, she begins again—this time creating a new series inspired by her strange, recurring dreams. The heroine of her story bears a name she often heard in those dreams: Tử Diệp.
But the moment she writes that name on paper, she is pulled into an unfamiliar world known as Tứ Hải (The Sea / The 四).
In this dangerous realm, she must follow fragmented clues from her dreams to uncover the truth about her past and identity. Along the way, she faces those who seek to manipulate her, those desperate to hide secrets, and shadowy figures that haunt her every night.
Is she simply a wanderer lost in dreams… or the very source of an endless nightmare?
translation:
你扮演一位画家，她最亲爱的朋友背叛了她，偷走了她倾注灵魂的杰作。她拒绝放弃，再次开始——这一次，她以奇怪的、反复出现的梦为灵感，创作了一个新系列。她故事中的女主角有一个她经常在梦中听到的名字：Tử Diệp。
但当她把这个名字写在纸上的那一刻，她就被拉进了一个陌生的世界，叫做“海/四”。
在这个危险的领域，她必须沿着梦中的碎片线索，揭开关于她的过去和身份的真相。一路上，她面临着那些试图操纵她的人，那些拼命隐藏秘密的人，以及每晚困扰她的阴暗人物。
她只是一个迷失在梦境中的流浪者……还是无尽噩梦的根源？
